name: Soo Yoo
office: Abc Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Soo Yoo has been a member of the ABC Unified School District Governing Board representing Trustee Area 2 since 2013. She owns a private tutoring company in Cerritos. She was elected board clerk in 2019. She served as board president in 2022.

sentences.text: Soo Yoo has been a member of the ABC Unified School District Governing Board representing Trustee Area 2 since 2013.
She owns a private tutoring company in Cerritos.
She was elected board clerk in 2019.
She served as board president in 2022.

items.text: In 2023 she criticized Common Core and suggested parents consider homeschooling or alternative schools. Los Cerritos Community News reported she attended a 'Detransition Awareness Rally' in Sacramento that year. In 2014 she voted to place a $195 million school improvement bond on the ballot after initially trying to delay it, and said Whitney High School was a 'school in decline.'
